headline: Quantum systems, circuits, and advanced error correction
summary: Today's research features a diverse set of advances across quantum computing, spanning hardware-aware compiler optimization, novel circuit constructions for algebraic structures, and enhanced decoding frameworks. Additional theoretical studies explore non-Hermitian spectral reshaping, exact relaxation dynamics, and nonlocal magic.

themes.title: Quantum Circuits and QFT Constructions
themes.body: New algebraic approaches and complexity refinements improve quantum Fourier transform circuits for specific group families and symmetric groups, while compiler search optimizes phase-term orderings to reduce routed CNOT gates.

themes.title: Quantum Many-Body Systems and Dynamics
themes.body: Researchers explore how long-range hoppings reshape non-Hermitian spectra, derive closed-form Ruelle-Pollicott resonances using CMV matrices, and quantify nonlocal magic in pure multiqubit states.

themes.title: Quantum Error Correction and Decoding
themes.body: A hierarchical neural message-passing framework is introduced to decode general concatenated stabilizer codes, significantly raising the depolarizing pseudo-threshold and lowering failure rates.
